title: A new website, docs and resources
summary: The site has a new design and clearer pages for each part of the product.

items.text: New Product, Features, How it works and Experiment analytics pages.
Solutions pages for marketing, SaaS, ecommerce and startup teams.
A developer hub with setup steps, code examples, the API and webhooks.
The docs have a new design. The JavaScript SDK reference now lives at /docs/javascript-sdk, and old links still work.
A new Integrations page lists what connects today and which plan each needs.
A Statistical methodology page explains every test we run, with formulas and worked examples.
Resources, curated guides, a product FAQ and this changelog.
Starter is $20 a month or $200 a year. Growth is $50 a month or $500 a year.
Starter includes 250,000 tested visitors a month and 20 running tests. Growth includes 1,000,000 tested visitors a month with no cap on running tests.
New About, Contact, Refunds and Service delivery pages.
Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, Data Processing Agreement and Cookie Policy.
A Security page that explains how your data and keys are protected.

title: AI suggestions and tidier test lists

items.text: AI suggestions for test ideas, hypotheses, copy and result summaries, using your own API key.
Every test can have a hypothesis, an expected outcome and up to 10 tags.
Duplicate a test into a new draft, and archive paused or completed tests.
The free plan includes 1 new test each month and 1 click goal per test, with no card and no time limit.

title: Server-side tests, multivariate tests and webhooks

items.text: Assign visitors and send events from your server with a secret key.
Multi-page tests and multivariate tests that try every combination of up to three changes.
Webhooks for winners, completed tests, split warnings and plan limits.
Download results as CSV.
Test planner: a board of test ideas with hypotheses, priorities and duration estimates.
Heatmaps for any page, even one without a test.
Every variant is compared with the control by a sequential test, so checking results often does not raise false winners.
Roll out the winning version to every visitor in one click while you update your code.
Schedule a start and end time, and ramp traffic up gradually.
Results by device, traffic source and new or returning visitors.
Preview links to check each version before you start.
Invite teammates with roles, and read every change in the audit log.

title: Visual editor, popups, surveys and funnels

items.text: A visual editor that changes text and layout on your page without code.
Popups and calls to action on your pages.
On-page surveys, including NPS.
JavaScript error tracking for each version.
Traffic overview of page views, sources and new visitors.
A Google Analytics 4 event for every version a visitor sees.
Auto-shift sends more traffic to versions that are doing better.
Revenue goals and funnels with a completion trend.
Form, page visit and custom event goals, alongside click goals.
items.feature: Form, page visit and custom event goals

items.text: Target visitors by device, campaign, referrer and new or returning.
Read-only share links for results.
A warning when visitors are not split as expected.
Install guides for Google Tag Manager and WordPress.
Documentation for setup, features and the API.
Split URL tests with a step-by-step setup.
Development, staging and production environments, each with its own keys.
